items.problem: Header declares package directory function used by R0038.
Select package keyboard resources instead of modern Windows system resources.

evidence: cmdGetKbdLayout builds KB16.COM then KEYBOARD.SYS paths and checks GetFileAttributes; missing resource goes to NoInstallkb16. Unlike cmd.c drive-only use this caller needs actual package resource directory.
recommendation: Retain explicit package directory lookup/header as resource-location boundary, subject to owner decision. No relocation into Windows directory authorized.
counter_review: This proves a reached-branch source/resource mismatch, not reproduced keyboard runtime failure or all layouts. US fast-paste may bypass installation. No claim that original algorithm is defective.
verification: Read-only path/source/hash evidence. No build/test needed for unchanged source. #error/#line unchanged, no whole-file line certification.
